cost_centres.description: Acme cost centres. Stored value is the cost centre code; the label is shown to the user.

departments.description: Departments. Stored value is the English code, the label is Bahasa Indonesia.

leave_types.description: Leave types. Stored value is the English code, the label is Bahasa Indonesia.

request_status.description: Status values every Acme request form uses, in lifecycle order.

approval_matrix.description: Purchase approval matrix. Amounts are in Rupiah (IDR). Use it to decide the number of approval steps in the process; the first rule whose maxAmount is not exceeded decides who approves last.

formats.description: Date, number and identifier formats. Use these when you set a field's data format, display format or default value.

rules.note: Day first. Show the same pattern the user types.
Rp before the amount, dot as thousands separator, comma as decimal separator.
Example REQ/2026/00017. Generate it with an ID generator field, never ask the user to type it.
